content:
VIDEO LAB 专项重构上线（v34）：

· 自动剪辑质量引擎：文案角色识别（Hook/List/Explanation/CTA 等 10 类）驱动镜头节奏；可解释语义匹配（置信度+匹配原因）；前后镜头重复惩罚；4 种剪辑风格（自然/快速/电影感/纪实）真实改变剪辑决策。
· 成片质量检查：重复素材、冷开场、无匹配场景自动告警并可一键跳转修复。
· 配音系统：新建流程与工作台均可试听；浏览器合成试听与真实音频分离；单句重新生成不影响其他片段。
· 工作台：多轨时间轴真实编辑（拖动/裁切/分割/删除/替换）；快捷键全套（Space/S/⌘Z/⌘⇧Z/⌘S/Delete/方向键逐帧/Home/End/M/缩放）并带输入框焦点保护；Undo/Redo 100 步。
· 字体与审美：6 套可辨识字体（含宋体/楷体）+ 6 种字幕风格预设（编辑式/知识简洁/关键词高亮/电影感/纪实/科技），真实写入项目并影响渲染与导出。
· 修复：横屏素材竖屏黑边（真实 cover 裁切）、配音重生成后续片段不位移、字体选择器损坏等。
· 导出：MP4 真实编码（WebCodecs+MP4 Muxer），导出后验证文件大小与时长；SRT 字幕导出；无真实配音时明确标注开发模式。
content_en:
VIDEO LAB major rebuild live (v34):

· Auto-edit quality engine: script-role recognition (Hook/List/Explanation/CTA and 10 roles) drives shot rhythm; explainable semantic matching (confidence + reason); repeat-penalty between consecutive shots; 4 edit styles (natural/fast/cinematic/documentary) that actually change editing decisions.
· Export quality check: repeated footage, cold open, unmatched scenes auto-alert with one-click jump to fix.
· Dubbing previewable in both new-flow and workbench.

I don't have an answer yet, so I keep trying.

content: VIDEO LAB v38：AI/TTS 接入重构完成——支持用户自带 OpenAI 兼容 API（DeepSeek/Moonshot/智谱/通义等），设置页新增真实连接测试、错误诊断分型（密钥无效/地址错误/超时/跨域）、能力分级与密钥清除；素材分析接入真实模型（视觉模型可选），密钥仅存浏览器本地。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v38: AI/TTS provider rework — bring-your-own OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek/Moonshot/Zhipu/Qwen…), real connection test with error classification, capability badges, key clearing; real media analysis with optional vision model; keys stay local in the browser.

content: VIDEO LAB v43：口播视频自动剪辑上线——上传口播视频/音频后，浏览器本地 Whisper 真实转录（带时间戳，无需服务器），自动按语义段剪辑、生成字幕、保留原声；可混入 B-roll 素材；导出 MP4 真实包含音轨（AAC 48kHz）。支持本地 Whisper（免费）/ 自带转录 API / 粘贴 SRT 三种来源。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v43: voiceover auto-cut — upload your talking video/audio, transcribe locally in the browser with Whisper (real timestamps, zero server), auto-cut by semantic segments, subtitle, keep the original audio, optional B-roll; exported MP4 carries a real AAC 48kHz audio track. Sources: local Whisper (free) / your transcription API / pasted SRT.

content: VIDEO LAB v44：产品转型为 AI 分镜与拍摄工作台（AI Video Pre-production Studio）——项目中心（9 类项目、复制/搜索/删除）、脚本工作台（段落化编辑、语速时长估算）、分镜编辑器（卡片/表格双视图、拖拽+上下移动排序、15 项镜头字段、参考图 Blob 本地存储、按状态筛选）、拍摄执行板（场景/道具/人物自动归类、任务清单、真实进度）、AI 创作助手（用户自带 OpenAI 兼容 API，结构化 JSON 输出经校验后预览确认才合并/替换，含分镜生成/画面优化/查漏/风格建议/中英视频提示词工具）、真实导出（Markdown/CSV/JSON 备份与导入恢复/中文正确可打印 PDF，pdf-lib 渲染）。全部浏览器本地 IndexedDB 存储，密钥仅存本地，零服务器。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v44: now an AI Pre-production Studio — Projects center (9 types, copy/search/delete), Script workspace (paragraph editing, WPM duration estimate), Storyboard editor (card/table views, drag + move buttons, 15 shot fields, reference-image blobs in IndexedDB, state filter), Production board (auto scene/prop/cast lists, tasks, real progress), AI Assistant (bring-your-own OpenAI-compatible API; structured JSON validated, previewed and confirmed before merge/replace; storyboard draft, visual polish, gap check, style advice, CN/EN video prompts), real exports (Markdown/CSV/JSON backup+restore/Chinese-safe print PDF via pdf-lib). Everything local in the browser (IndexedDB), keys stay local, zero server.

content: VIDEO LAB v55：修复 AI 生成链路三个真实 bug——①已配置 API 用户点击“生成分镜方案”无反应（aiassist 把 config() 当属性读，永远误报“尚未配置”）；②chatJSON 未导出导致请求中断；③错误分型参数顺序错误，API Key 无效等真实错误无法正确显示。现错误信息精确区分鉴权/地址/参数/限流/网络问题；生成→结构化校验→预览确认→合并/替换全链路本地验证通过。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v55: fixed three real bugs in the AI generation path — 1) the Generate button did nothing for users who had configured an API (aiassist read config() as a property, always mis-reporting 'not configured'); 2) chatJSON wasn't exported, breaking the request; 3) error classification args were swapped so real auth failures couldn't display. Now errors distinguish auth/endpoint/bad-request/rate-limit/network; the full chain generate -> validate -> preview -> merge/replace is verified locally.

content: VIDEO LAB v56：视觉重构为深色电影工作台——炭黑底色 + 深橙强调，达芬奇/Premiere 级创作软件质感。重构项目中心卡片（类型图标封面、Talking head 双语标签、镜头数徽标、hover 抬升）、分镜编辑器（镜头卡编号块与状态 chips、空状态插画引导 + 一键新建镜头）、顶部工具栏（类型+页面面包屑、保存状态徽标、撤销/重做/导出主次分明）；修复弹窗类名错位导致样式失效的问题；表格/设置/导出/拍摄板/提示条全页深色化，支持系统减少动效。
content_en: VIDEO LAB v56: dark cinema workstation — charcoal base + deep orange accent, DaVinci/Premiere-grade craft feel. Rebuilt project cards (type glyph cover, bilingual label, shot-count badge, hover lift), storyboard (shot number block & state chips, illustrated empty state with one-click New Shot), topbar (type+page breadcrumb, save-state badge, clear undo/redo/export hierarchy); fixed modal class mismatch that broke dialog styling; full-page dark theme for table/settings/export/production/toasts, respects reduced-motion.
